channel.title: Projects on John Poirier | Portfolio
channel.description: Recent content in Projects on John Poirier | Portfolio

item.title: Autonomous Weeder Robot
item.description: An autonomous robot that finds dandelions with machine vision, drives to them, and removes them mechanically. I led all work in software and autonomy.

item.title: EKF SLAM in ROS2
item.description: A ROS2 simulation of an omnidirectional robot that maps its surroundings while tracking its own position, using an extended Kalman filter, ICP scan matching, and an occupancy grid. Also includes an exploration of visual SLAM with ORB-SLAM3.

item.title: Wlkata Mirobot Robotic Arm Control
item.description: A ROS2 control stack for a physical 6-axis Wlkata Mirobot arm, built up from joint commands to an optimization-based inverse kinematics solver and pure pursuit tracking of paths the user draws.

item.title: Color Detector Module
item.description: An Arduino color detector that flashes red, green, and blue light at a surface, measures the reflections with a single light-dependent resistor, and names the closest of 672 colors on an LCD.

item.title: Self-Driving Car Simulation
item.description: A simulated self-driving car with a PI cruise controller, a cascaded steering controller, a fuel-optimizing model predictive controller, and a lane-change state machine, cutting fuel use 18% while keeping a safe following distance.

item.title: Line-Following Robot & Starger Circuit
item.description: An autonomous line-following robot on a PCB I laid out, running register-level C on an ATtiny1634, which placed 3rd of 25+ in the class race with the fastest single run (44 s), plus the Starger race-starter and power-supply board.

item.title: Inductive Wireless Power Transfer
item.description: A modular inductive wireless power transfer prototype, tuned to resonance at 91 kHz, that delivered power across a gap at up to 63.9% efficiency, with a hand-wound phase-splitting transformer and coils.
